evidence_cutoff.working_tree_note: The pre-existing working tree contained active numerical modifications and many temporary/untracked products. They were neither stopped nor modified by this read-only school pass.

executive_reconstruction.physical_program: BHSM is a geometry-first research program in which one closed hyperspherical parent system, its topology, boundary/collar structure, and action-owned fields are intended to generate physical spacetime organization and particle-sector structure. Modes are not automatically particles. Physical objecthood requires an action-supported formation/enclosure history, admissible boundary/topological data, and whatever persistence or confinement the relevant sector requires.
executive_reconstruction.encapsulation_core: Encapsulation is the finite local completion event by which propagating or locally driven action-owned energy-geometry data close into an admissible, constraint-complete event output or child. It is not required to be an eternal soliton, and positive-duration child continuation is a separate claim. The July envelopment language was broader than this event notion.
executive_reconstruction.central_finding: The corpus recovers a consistent physical distinction among formation, event completion, event-to-child correspondence, and later persistence. The current N12 mathematics rigorously establishes selected singular-stop and child-continuation facts, but the identification of the selected branch-24 Hessian zero with the full physical encapsulation or with a localized spacetime pocket remains author-scoped rather than action-derived. This is the confirmed drift.
executive_reconstruction.gate7_label_finding: The ordinal label Gate 7 was repeatedly renumbered and cannot itself be treated as an invariant historical object. In the late-August flagship lineage it meant gauge/source-functional, force/KKT, saddle, Hessian, Ward/trace, and scalar-readout closure on an actual forward history. A finite branch-24 stop became an endpoint used by that lineage; it did not replace the remaining force/full-field/physical-identification obligations.
executive_reconstruction.recommended_public_rule: A mathematical subgate may certify a same-action parent history reaching the selected earliest stop. Public or physical GATE_7_CLOSED must be withheld until the stop is identified, from the action and on the required physical field domain, as the intended encapsulation event and is connected consistently to its child.

access_manifest.sufficiency_decision: The missing sources limit verbatim recovery of some older metaphors, especially 'straight road', 'bumps', 'turbulence', 'time and distance are outputs', and '3D knot roaming the EM field'. They do not block reconstruction of the governing BHSM ontology because explicit author corrections, prompts, committed doctrine, and theorem artifacts cover the critical formation/event/child distinctions. Outcome E is therefore not warranted.

evidence_policy.rule: Later terminology was not allowed to retroactively redefine earlier physical statements. Conversely, author ontology was not relabeled as an action theorem.

fundamental_substrate.definition: One closed hyperspherical energy-geometry system with compact internal geometry, topology, boundary/collar strata, and action-owned fields. The corpus contains historical 'Aether' and core/singularity modules, but current AE2 does not justify an independent material aether, independent energy field, primitive preferred frame, or primitive spacetime field in the core.
fundamental_substrate.time_and_distance: The accessible corpus supports physical time as an oriented lapse/proper-time output of the spacetime branch and treats core-to-spacetime correspondence as open. The stronger phrase 'time and distance are outputs' appears in the present request but was not recovered verbatim from an earlier accessible record; it remains author ontology, not a derived theorem.
fundamental_substrate.boundary_bulk: Boundary and collar data are physical organizing structures, not arbitrary cutoffs. A genuine spacetime boundary retains induced geometry, lapse, radius, normals, matching data, and boundary operators. Bulk/internal modes require a boundary/action attachment before physical promotion.

field.definition: An action-owned geometric, gauge, fermionic, scalar/topographic, or response degree of freedom on the relevant bulk/boundary domain. A field or harmonic mode is not automatically an on-shell particle.

particle.definition: A sector-dependent physical class, not one universal ontology. The corpus distinguishes propagating on-shell fields, internal modes, confined fundamental modes, event-born child histories, and downstream composites.

event and enclosure history when applicable

not_equivalent_to: a unique point after quotienting physical position, momentum, orientation, or phase freedoms

envelopment.definition: The broad July 2026 process by which action-supported energy and geometry form an envelope at any scale through propagation, curvature, topology, or environmental coupling. Persistent envelopment and self-supported/topological objecthood were higher stages.
envelopment.relation_to_encapsulation: Distinct but overlapping. Envelopment is the broad formation/support architecture; encapsulation was corrected in August to a finite completion event. Treating them as exact synonyms is terminology drift.

encapsulation.definition: A finite event along an action-owned forward history: local environment or interaction drives a threshold/instability, nonlinear growth and mode selection/locking occur, constraints/domain and energy accounting close, and a locally admissible completed configuration is related to an outgoing child. The event may leave a transient, metastable, stable, converting, or dispersing result.

necessary_distinctions.formation: pre-event causal approach and nonlinear organization
necessary_distinctions.reset: the event-to-child correspondence or chart/domain transfer
necessary_distinctions.stability: a separate dynamical or topological theorem
necessary_distinctions.destruction: loss of enclosure/support, interaction, conversion, decay, de-encapsulation, or dispersion

not_required: one universal mechanism across all sectors

parent.definition: The pre-event action solution and its maximal causal formation history in the common closed system, including geometry, momenta, constraints, environment, boundary/interface, and any attached physical fields. It is not merely a solver box or a cosmologically separate universe.

child.definition: A constraint-complete post-event state/history in the regular set-valued event-to-child relation. The N12 child includes retained geometry coordinates, velocities, and multipliers and admits positive-duration evolution, but those facts alone do not select a particle family or prove an independently encapsulated spacetime pocket.

reset.definition: In the durable mathematical implementation, a set-valued event-to-new-child glue, trace/conormal graph, or chart/domain transfer. It does not mean recurrence or a physical return to the same state.
reset.semantic_history: Some August prompts used reset for de-encapsulation/interaction/destruction, while later corrections said there is no physical reset. These are reconciled by reserving 'reset relation' for the mathematical event-child correspondence and using formation, interaction, decay, or de-encapsulation for physics.

persistence.definition: Existence of an admissible forward child history for a strictly positive proper-time interval.

gate7_intent_determination.answer: The label Gate 7 never had a single project-long original meaning. For the late-August lineage relevant now, it was intended to establish action-owned physical gauge/source/force/Hessian/readout closure on an actual physical forward history. Norman's encapsulation doctrine required that the history's endpoint be a genuine finite local completion event. Therefore the useful 7A/7B split is an internal proof decomposition, while the public physical gate cannot be called closed until both the mathematical endpoint and its physical encapsulation identity are established.
gate7_intent_determination.closest_requested_option: C: the split is mathematically useful internally, but public/physical Gate 7 cannot be called closed until both are complete.
gate7_intent_determination.G7_A_to_E: In the recovered event doctrine, B and C are intended; A is necessary but insufficient; D is a separate persistence/stability gate; E is too strong because permanent stability was explicitly retired.

lambda24_provenance.mathematical_meaning: lambda_24 is the action-selected simple eigenvalue of a reduced Euler-Dirac Hessian/eigenline, with 24 being its ordering index at N12 resolution. lambda_24=0 marks loss of invertibility/marginality of that selected reduced line. Together with orientation and the singular normal form it supplies a canonical terminal stop and local finite-time approach.
lambda24_provenance.why_earliest: The exact spectrum cover proves the selected line remains strictly positive before the terminal bracket and the bracket endpoints have opposite signs; continuity supplies an earliest zero along that certified history. It does not prove unique or differentiable stop time, and those were not claimed.
lambda24_provenance.physical_interpretation: A candidate terminal singular event on the retained geometry history. Norman's owner ontology authorized calling the locally reached singular event completed encapsulation, but no action theorem identifies the Hessian-zero set with local spacetime enclosure, a particle family, or charged-lepton topology.
lambda24_provenance.reason: Branch 24 arose from numerical resolution transport of an already selected N6 eigenline, after the encapsulation doctrine had been stated. No earlier author source defines encapsulation as the 24th eigenvalue reaching zero.

spacetime_child_determination.historical_intent: Encapsulation language repeatedly invokes coupled energy-geometry closure, a local environment, boundary/collar data, and a completed local configuration. Earlier envelopment work also distinguished intrinsic enclosure data from external embedding/attachment data. This supports an intended localized geometric object class.
spacetime_child_determination.current_N12_state: The retained N12 local adapter has 37 geometry coordinates, 37 geometry velocities, and 24 multipliers. The event-child relation closes constraints, zero Legendre-energy rows, regularity margins, and a positive-duration child history.
spacetime_child_determination.critical_answer: The N12 child is a mathematical geometric child candidate, but the current theorem does not prove that it possesses its own independently encapsulated spacetime geometry. No action-derived theorem presently constructs a new interior domain with its induced metric, lapse/shift, normal and second fundamental form, collar/junction matching, boundary Hamiltonian, and separation from the parent as a physical enclosure.
spacetime_child_determination.which_particles_carry_local_spacetime_do: No named Standard Model particle is currently proved to carry its own localized spacetime domain. The singular-event child class is the candidate; charged-lepton 2pi closure, propagating modes, confined modes, and composites must not be assigned such a domain without separate evidence.

lost_but_valid_ideas: The July envelopment hierarchy: broad formation, persistent envelopment, self-support, and topological/quantized objecthood are distinct levels.
Encapsulation requires an action-owned local environment, nonlinear completion, domain/constraint closure, energy/Noether accounting, mode selection, and a consistent outgoing state.
Intrinsic enclosure data and external embedding/attachment data are different; fixed intrinsic geometry during motion is a nontrivial constraint, not automatic.
